Chicago Pizza
Chicago Pizza – Sapa, Vietnam 🇻🇳

Our family had a wonderful dining experience at Chicago Pizza. The food was absolutely delicious, with fresh ingredients and excellent flavors. Every dish we ordered was prepared with great care.

A special thank you to Mr. Phu for his kindness, professionalism, and exceptional service. He patiently explained the menu, helped us choose the best dishes, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our visit. His warm hospitality made our experience even more enjoyable.

We highly recommend Chicago Pizza to anyone visiting Sapa.

With appreciation,
Abdulwahab, Noureyah, Almasah & Raad Alghamdi
Abha & Jeddah, Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦

---

Chicago Pizza – سابا، فيتنام 🇻🇳

استمتعنا كعائلة بتجربة رائعة في مطعم Chicago Pizza. كان الطعام لذيذًا جدًا، والمكونات طازجة، والنكهات مميزة، وكل الأطباق التي طلبناها كانت شهية ومُحضرة بعناية.

شكر خاص للسيد Phu على لطفه، واحترافيته، واهتمامه الكبير براحتنا. فقد حرص على شرح قائمة الطعام لنا، وساعدنا في اختيار الأطباق المناسبة، وكان تعامله راقيًا وودودًا طوال زيارتنا، مما جعل تجربتنا أكثر متعة.

ننصح بكل ثقة بزيارة Chicago Pizza لكل من يزور مدينة سابا.

Great food!
Dec 2025 • Couples
Had our dinner there - ordered 1 deep dish pizza which was very cheesy, 1 chicken fried rice - which was very fragrant and tasty and 1 bbq wings (comes with sweet bbq-like sauce and nice thick fries!). I had their fruit tea (hot) which was really fruity and nice especially in the cold weather and my husband had the saigon beer which he said was very nice and goes well with the food. 

Food took some time to serve though no crowd but would say the wait was still okay (around 15mins). Overall a good experience!
